Media

Purpose: images, video, and audio that reserve their space, keep their

Purpose: images, video, and audio that reserve their space, keep their captions, and never shift the page. No external dependencies.

Figures

<figure class="sq-figure">
  <img
    src="harbor.jpg"
    alt="Cranes over berth 7 at dawn"
    width="1600"
    height="900"
  />
  <figcaption>Berth 7 handles the morning arrivals.</figcaption>
</figure>

width/height attributes reserve the ratio before load (no layout shift); alt carries the content (empty alt="" only for purely decorative images); captions are muted, measured prose.

Responsive containers

<div class="sq-media">
  <iframe
    src="…"
    title="Harbor overview film"
    loading="lazy"
    allow="fullscreen"
  ></iframe>
</div>

16:9 default, --square, --wide. Children fill the reserved box; iframes need title; loading="lazy" below the fold. The sunken background shows while content loads — never a white flash or a collapsing box.

Audio

<audio class="sq-audio" controls src="foghorn.mp3">
  <a href="foghorn.mp3">Download the recording (MP3)</a>
</audio>

Native controls, full width. The fallback link inside serves engines without audio support. Never autoplay; never hide controls.

Placeholders

<div class="sq-media-placeholder" role="img" aria-label="Loading chart…">
  Chart loading…
</div>

Fixed-ratio shells (never auto-height) with a text label naming what loads. Replace with the real figure when ready — same footprint, zero shift.

Carousel

<div class="sq-carousel" data-sq-carousel>
  <div
    class="sq-carousel__track"
    tabindex="0"
    role="region"
    aria-roledescription="carousel"
    aria-label="Shape studies"
  >
    <figure class="sq-carousel__slide">
      <img src="study-1.jpg" alt="…" width="1200" height="800" />
      <figcaption>Study one</figcaption>
    </figure>
    <figure class="sq-carousel__slide">
      <img src="study-2.jpg" alt="…" width="1200" height="800" />
      <figcaption>Study two</figcaption>
    </figure>
  </div>
  <div class="sq-carousel__controls">
    <button
      class="sq-button sq-button--secondary sq-button--icon-only sq-carousel__prev"
      type="button"
      aria-label="Previous slides"
    >
      <svg
        class="sq-icon"
        viewBox="0 0 24 24"
        fill="none"
        stroke="currentColor"
        stroke-width="2"
        stroke-linecap="round"
        stroke-linejoin="round"
        focusable="false"
      >
        <path d="m15 6-6 6 6 6" />
      </svg>
    </button>
    <button
      class="sq-button sq-button--secondary sq-button--icon-only sq-carousel__next"
      type="button"
      aria-label="Next slides"
    >
      <svg
        class="sq-icon"
        viewBox="0 0 24 24"
        fill="none"
        stroke="currentColor"
        stroke-width="2"
        stroke-linecap="round"
        stroke-linejoin="round"
        focusable="false"
      >
        <path d="m9 6 6 6-6 6" />
      </svg>
    </button>
  </div>
</div>
<script>
  Squircle.init(); // or Squircle.initCarousels(document)
</script>

Snap scrolling is CSS; the controls are the only runtime piece. Slides page one .sq-carousel__slide at a time; --half shows two per page. The buttons disable at the ends (computed sign-agnostically, so RTL tracks behave), re-enable on any scroll, and page instantly under reduced motion. The track itself keyboard-pans (Arrow keys) because it is focusable; control buttons are optional — swipe and keyboard work without them. Content inside slides is authored freely (figures, cards); keep each slide's height within reason (the track is one row).

Accessibility

  • Every informative image has alt; decorative images have empty

alt AND no figcaption pointing at them.

  • Iframes are titled; video keeps captions where the medium needs them

(<track kind="captions"> — author-provided, documented, not magic).

  • Audio never autoplays; transcripts accompany meaningful audio

(author-provided, beside the player).

  • Placeholders are labeled regions, not silent boxes.

Theme behavior

Borders, sunken wells, captions, and placeholder dashes are tokens. Media content itself is theme-agnostic (photographs do not re-skin).

Customization

Ratios beyond 16:9/square/wide are page CSS (aspect-ratio + object-fit: cover). Keep the border/radius pairing so media reads as Squircle surfaces.

Responsive behavior

Media is fluid by construction (width: 100%, height: auto or ratio boxes). Figures never overflow narrow viewports; captions wrap at measure.

Common mistakes

  • Missing width/height on images — the classic layout-shift bug.
  • alt describing the file ("IMG_0042.jpg") instead of the content.
  • Background-image for content images — invisible to AT and print.
  • Autoplaying video with sound — blocked by browsers, hated by users.
  • Placeholders that collapse (min-height mysteries) — fixed ratios only.
  • Carousel autoplay with no pause — auto-cycling carousels trade

comprehension for motion; Squircle carousels move only when the user asks.

Tested limitations

  • No lightbox/zoom behavior (application concern; styles compose with it).
  • <track> caption files are author-provided; rendering is platform-native.
  • Art direction (picture/srcset) is markup, fully supported, unstyled.
  • Carousel counts ("slide 2 of 5") are not auto-announced — add an

aria-live region if your application depends on it.
